title: Activepieces White Label Pricing: Cost by Plan (2026)
summary: Activepieces white label starts at $36,000 per year on the Embed tier. Get the pricing breakdown and understand which plans support embedding.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


### Can I white label Activepieces on the Free or Plus plan?


No. White labelling, meaning the builder running under your own brand inside your product, sits in the Embed tier. Free and Plus are self-serve plans for using the product under its own branding, so check the tier before you commit design work to a rebrand.


If your requirement document says "customer-facing, our brand", Embed's the only line that matches it, and sales quotes it.


### Is the Activepieces Community Edition enough for white labelling?


No. For running automations internally under the standard branding, the Community Edition's enough. Once the requirement is to present the builder as part of your own product, it's not.


**The constraint is licensing, not capability** .


You can run the free edition on your own hardware, and that may be all an internal team needs. Embedding it under your brand is a separate commercial arrangement.


### Does Activepieces hold SOC 2 certification?


No. The vendor describes SOC 2 as a programme in progress, not a completed certification. If your procurement or audit window requires a report, treat the item as open.


Ask sales what stage the programme has reached and what they can supply in the meantime, and get the answer in writing. Don't copy "SOC 2" into your own security documentation until a report exists.


### Can I self-host the embedded version?


You will not find the answer in the self-serve plans. Whether the embedded version can be self-hosted, and under what terms, is a deployment question for sales.


If you run with no outbound internet, or inside a restricted network, say so in your first message. Deployment model is one of the factors that shapes the quote.


### What do I need ready before I talk to sales?


Before you open the[sales form](https://www.activepieces.com/sales) , have these written down.


Say where it will run: their cloud or your own infrastructure, and any network restrictions. Say how many people will build flows, and how many of your customers will see the builder.


Give the expected automation volume, since usage credits drive cost, and say whether you need SSO beyond what Team provides. Add your support expectations, including response times, and any security documentation your procurement process requires.


The[pricing page](https://www.activepieces.com/pricing) lists the self-serve plans; sales handles everything else.
